title: Dispatch: olc5.13 close the deduction-table contract exhaustively (Sol r2 S3-S4) (attempt 3)
description:
Repair after Sol r2 eshyra-olc5.13.4 (read S3 and S4 with probes). Branch from eshyra-olc5.13 @ ac0a1be3. Sol r1 and r2 both found siblings at the SAME boundary, so close it exhaustively in this one pass, not just the two named cases.

Write ONE shared contract function (used by BOTH pack admission in packages/core/src/rules/validate.ts and the resolved-table execution boundary in packages/core/src/state/itemResetExecutor.ts) that checks a deduction effect against the effective table and economy, covering every field: economy exists on the item and is a numeric pool; tableRef resolves; columns is an array of strings; keyColumn and amountColumn each occur EXACTLY once and are different columns; every row is an array of exactly columns.length cells; every key cell is a non-empty string, keys unique; every amount cell is either a safe non-negative integer number, an integer string within safe range, or a dice expression whose FULL possible range [minimumDiceTotal, maximumDiceTotal] (add maximumDiceTotal next to minimumDiceTotal in packages/core/src/orchestrator/dice.ts, keep/drop and modifier aware) lies within [0, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER]. Execution keeps its post-roll safe-integer guard as defence in depth. Admission of a pack whose own effect declares a deduction must fail on any violation; execution must refuse atomically (whole DB unchanged) when the resolved stack violates it.

Permanent evidence: one table-driven test enumerating each contract clause above with a violating case (duplicate key header, duplicate amount header, same column for both, short/long row, non-string header, unsafe dice ceiling incl. kh/dl siblings, straddling range, negative floor) run through BOTH admission and execution on independently validated base + table-only add-on, plus valid boundary controls (exact MAX_SAFE ceiling allowed, 0 allowed). Do not touch unrelated code; no pack regeneration expected (stop and report if needed). Run npm run verify:worktree before committing. Completion notes: clause -> test row table, verify result.
notes:
Dispatched as Claude Haiku 5.5 Agent; worktree .worktrees/eshyra-olc5.13.5 from eshyra-olc5.13 @ ac0a1be3.
COMPLETION REPORT (olc5.13.5, Haiku 5.5 dispatch, repair of Sol r2 S3-S4). Commit 526d8859 on eshyra-olc5.13.5 (base ac0a1be3). verify:worktree exit 0 (364 files passed, 2 skipped; 6872 tests passed, 3 skipped; typecheck clean; Biome only the pre-existing biome.json schema info, eshyra-wmke). Not pushed, no PR, no beads:sync, no changes to eshyra-olc5.13 or eshyra-olc5.

PLAN CHECK: plan matched the code. The shared contract lives in packages/core/src/rules/magicItemMechanics.ts (not a new module: a new src module would need an entry in the deterministicCapabilityInventory module-disposition registry, which the inventory test enforces; the existing types home is simpler). Both callers import economyDeductionViolation.

PROBES. Reproduced before the fix on the real item_state_event path: S3 duplicate amount header (1 then 12) deducted 1 and persisted 35; key-column sibling persisted 33. S4 1d2+9007199254740991, 2d20kh1+9007199254740991, 4d6dl1+9007199254740991 were admitted by validateRulesPack and refused at execution. After the fix all are refused at admission (validateRulesPack throws) and at execution (ItemResetExecutorError, DB unchanged, 36 charges).

WHAT CHANGED
- dice.ts: maximumDiceTotal beside minimumDiceTotal; shared keptDiceCount helper (keep/drop and modifier aware).
- magicItemMechanics.ts: economyDeductionViolation(check) returns the first violated clause or undefined. Economy must exist and be kind charges or per-day. tableRef must resolve; columns must be an array of strings; rows must be an array; keyColumn and amountColumn must each occur exactly once and differ; every row has exactly columns.length cells; every key cell is a non-empty string, keys unique; every amount is a safe non-negative integer number, a safe digit string, or dice whose [min,max] lies in [0, MAX_SAFE].
- validate.ts: admission calls the contract for every deduction on the item and its variants. Variant economies now merge the base item economies, as the effective mechanics do (before, a variant could not draw on a base economy at admission).
- itemResetExecutor.ts: deductionRows calls the same contract on the resolved table before any row is selected, rolled, or written. The post-roll safe-integer guard in deductionAmount is kept.
- Existing message fragments are preserved (the negative-numeric message keeps the executor wording 'resolved to -7, which is not a non-negative integer' so the pre-existing test is unchanged).

TEST EVIDENCE: new describe 'shared economy deduction contract (eshyra-olc5.13.5)' in packages/core/test/itemResetExecutor.test.ts. No existing test was weakened or edited.
Clause to test row:
- keyColumn absent / amountColumn absent: admission + execution via independently validated add-on (valid table).
- keyColumn occurs twice / amountColumn occurs twice: same (S3).
- keyColumn and amountColumn same column: base-record edit, admission + execution (unvalidated resolver) - effect-level, an add-on cannot carry it.
- non-string header, short row, long row: generic table schema refuses them, so admission refuses; the add-on cannot validate, so execution is run through the unvalidated resolver and must refuse with the contract's structural wording (asserted explicitly).
- non-string key cell, empty key cell, duplicate key: admission + execution.
- negative numeric, fractional numeric, NaN numeric, non-dice text, unsafe integer string: admission + execution.
- dice negative floor (1d2-3, 2d4-8): admission + execution.
- dice ceiling beyond safe range (1d2+MAX), keep sibling (2d20kh1+MAX), drop sibling (4d6dl1+MAX), straddling range (1d2+MAX-1): admission + execution.
- economy not declared (base record edit, both paths): refused.
- tableRef does not resolve (base record edit, both paths): refused.
- Valid controls, admitted and executed to a correct deduction: zero; exact MAX numeric; exact MAX string; 1d2+(MAX-2) max = MAX; 2d20kh1+(MAX-20) max = MAX; 4d6dl1+(MAX-18) max = MAX.
- Whole-database equality on every refusal; 36 charges retained.
Mutation check: with the pre-fix src stashed, 23 of the new cases fail; with the fix all 91 tests in itemResetExecutor.test.ts pass.

FOLLOW-UPS: eshyra-gxt7 (P3): confirm per-day economies are valid deduction pools; the contract currently accepts charges and per-day. eshyra-w750 (P2, existing) is the eager add-on admission check and can now call economyDeductionViolation directly; I did not change w750.
